result.title: When Learned IDS Model Selection Collapses to a Static Choice: A Measurement Study at the Edge
result.summary: Runtime model selection trades detection quality against energy and latency. However, comparing a selector only with a more costly static detector conflates detector choice with the benefit of adaptation. We present a framework for analysis and physical measurement that combines a pairwise reward criterion, matched static controls, paired blocks, a fixed load-prevalence factorial design, and reporting of actions outside training support. On one Raspberry Pi 4B with four frozen TON-IoT detectors, tabular Q-learning and a deep Q-network (DQN) both select LightLR throughout. A retrospective audit using validation data only rules out preference reversals for MedRF versus LightLR and HeavyMLP versus LightLR. However, TinyDT has a higher reward than LightLR in seven of the 2,500 windows, so the audit does not establish global LightLR optimality. We also evaluate a causal DeadlineGuard rule under a fixed factorial design with three arrival rates (50, 100, and 4,000 rows/s) and three attack prevalences (0.10, 0.50, and 0.90). Compared with Static-MedRF, DeadlineGuard saves 43.7 J per 500-s run (2.98%; 95% paired CI 41.4--46.0 J) and eliminates all 512 deadline misses among 5,000 windows, at a cost of 1.373 percentage points in F1. Outside training support, Tabular-Q's deterministic tie-breaking rule selects TinyDT, resulting in a false-positive rate of 67.76%. These single-board results motivate joint audits of reward attainability, realized actions, attribution against matched static controls, service feasibility, and default actions outside training support.

AI.brief_summary: 在 Raspberry Pi 4B 上用四个冻结的 TON-IoT 检测器检验运行时模型选择，结合配对静态对照、固定因子设计与物理测量，比较 Q-learning/DQN 选择器和 DeadlineGuard 规则在检测质量、能耗与截止期错失上的得失，并审计选择器退化为静态 LightLR 及训练支持域外的默认动作。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文关于成本约束下自适应选择器退化为静态选择、支持域外动作与配对静态基线的分析框架，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等动态计算与停止策略的收益归因和失败模式评价提供概念性启发，可供核查。
